name: Lissajous Tiles
description: The picture breaks into tiles that swirl along Lissajous curves and flip one by one to the second clip before settling back. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: speed
params.description: Speed of the tiles along their curves

params.name: freq
params.description: Number of loops of the curve, horizontally and vertically

params.name: offset
params.description: Extra vertical speed, which bends the curve

params.name: zoom
params.description: Size of the curve, relative to the frame

params.name: back_color
params.description: Color between the tiles (`#00000000` leaves it transparent, as in the original)
